snippet.title: Hex Core - Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
Hex Core is a short incremental clicker game. PeteOS is your line of defense against viruses, and you’re working toward clearing them completely. Between fights you funnel resources into a deep tree of upgrades that open new mechanics, weapons, and research paths. When you’re ready, you execute another run. 

Play the demo: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4478560/Hex_Core/

Each run climbs in difficulty and in what you earn, so turning the dial up always costs something and pays something back.
